text.p: CAM International Holdings said on Monday it was strengthening its management team with the appointment of a new general manager and a group financial controller with immediate effect.

The company said Lee Kwong Loong was the new general manager and Loy Soo Toon the financial controller. They would be responsible for handling day-to-day activities at the group level, it said in a statement.
Electronics-based CAM is under investigation by the Commercial Affairs Department on possible fraud charges against two its directors.
The company's auditors sent a report to the Finance Ministry saying two CAM directors may have committed breaches of trust in suspicious transactions through CAM subsidiaries.
